description: This file implements the HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) algorithm, including functions for initializing a HMAC context, updating it with data, and finalizing to produce the digest. It interfaces with hash functions provided via parameters and supports different hash algorithms. The implementation is part of the cURL project's security/authentication code.

methods.name: struct:HMAC_context * Curl_HMAC_init(const struct HMAC_params * hashparams,const unsigned char * key,unsigned int keylen)
methods.description: Initializes and allocates a new HMAC context based on provided hash parameters and key.

methods.name: int Curl_HMAC_update(struct HMAC_context * ctxt,const unsigned char * data,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Feeds data into the HMAC context for hashing.

methods.name: int Curl_HMAC_final(struct HMAC_context * ctxt,unsigned char * result)
methods.description: Finalizes the HMAC calculation and produces the digest.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_hmacit(const struct HMAC_params * hashparams,const unsigned char * key,const size_t keylen,const unsigned char * data,const size_t datalen,unsigned char * output)
methods.description: High-level function that performs HMAC calculation using specified parameters, key, and data.
